title: fire_alarm
description: Adds a new fire alarm block, pull station, sprinkler and panel.
body:
# Known Issues;

Fire alarm and panel not being in their hitboxes.
Linking tool not working.

# Upcoming Fixes/Changes;

Fixing hitbox issues.
Making the sprinkler model bigger(I know.. its really small)
